bio.text: Li Arellano Jr. has served as the Illinois State Senator for the 37th District since being sworn in on January 8, 2025.
He is a U.S. Army veteran and was Mayor of Dixon from 2015 to 2023.
According to the legislature biography, he opened his first restaurant at age 26 and is a squad leader in the Army Reserves.
